summary: [review:resume-restarts] start --resume with no tracked record and no kind/id/branch match begins a fresh run at step 1; after a merge that re-pushes the deleted branch and tries a second PR. Answering "nothing to resume" may be safer (owner-decided default was a fresh run)

[review:resume-branch-source] the resume branch comes from implement.json branch, but the run recorded whatever branch was current at start; when the two differ the kept record never matches and the run restarts
[review:sweep-resume] sweep work has no implement.json and a new timestamp id per invocation, so a detached sweep run can never be matched on resume
[review:merged-context] mergedContext folds a stop result data {merged:true} into context without mergedHead; harmless today because the cursor stays on merge
[review:pointer-race] a detach in one worktree can move current.json back to an older run while a newer run under the same slug runs in another worktree
[review:pointer-unchecked] with no tracked file loadState follows the pointer without checking branch; if start fails on a new branch, status reads the old branch run
[review:dead-code] an unreachable trailing return fail(unknown link) remains in check()
